title: La vida cotidiana
goal: Read how colonial cities were literally designed by royal decree, how markets blurred official legal separation, and the bishop who reportedly paid with his life for banning chocolate.

items: Explain why so many colonial cities share the same layout.
Describe what actually happened to the legal separation between 'two republics' in daily life.
Tell the story of the Chiapas chocolate dispute.
Explain what made the plaza the real social center of a colonial city.
Use 'a lo largo de', 'a raíz de' and 'como consecuencia de' to order and explain daily events.
